title: Q-BLIND-backup-restore: close the continuity blind spot backup-restore
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed backup-restore
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 8 within 168 h
**Status:** open

Why the owner would not know to ask: A backup never restored is a hope; the founder is one person.
Action: foundation/backup.py: weekly export of every D1 database and KV namespace, restore into a scratch SQLite database, row counts compared, dumps stored in R2 and read back. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.
